openai.reasoning: The respondent treats the game as a coordination problem with two equilibria and repeatedly claims both buttons are equally rational under uncertainty, while never committing to the dominant-strategy insight that pressing red is individually safe regardless of others; they also provide no clear personal button choice.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent provides a comprehensive game-theoretic analysis, correctly identifying the coordination nature of the game and the existence of two Nash equilibria. They acknowledge the concept of payoff-dominance and focal points (Schelling points) to explain why blue is often chosen, but they fail to identify that red is the strictly dominant strategy (as red-pressers survive regardless of the majority outcome). Because they treat the game as a pure coordination problem where both choices carry the risk of death, they miss the dominance structure entirely.
